lyrics:
I.   We have come into his house
and gathered in His Name to worship Him (2)
We have come into his house
and gathered in His Name to worship  
Christ the Lord, worship him, 
Jesus Christ the Lord.

2.   Let's forget about ourselves
And concentrate on him and worship him, (2)
Let's forget about ourselves
And concentrate on him and worship
Christ the Lord, worship him, 
Jesus Christ the Lord.

3.   We have come into his house
To magnify the Lord and praise His Name, (2)
We have come into his house
To magnify the Lord and praise His Holy Name, 
praise Him, Jesus Christ the Lord.
